Maintainer handoff: typstR 0.1.0

Source: RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md

Planning milestone v1.5 is independent of package version 0.1.0. Historical v1.4 check results are retained, but do not establish current readiness.

Audit correction verification

The October 26 audit identified additional defects after the historical milestone verification. See tools/audit-verification.md for the corrective changes, toolchains, fresh check results, and remaining hosted verification. Historical passes remain historical; require all three current PDF lanes (Linux minimum, Linux pinned, Windows pinned) on the reviewed release commit.

Quarto 1.4.11 needs standalone Typst on PATH; the compatibility lane pins Typst 0.15.1. Newer Quarto uses its bundled compiler. Required assurance now renders nine PDFs: unchanged defaults, identified enriched documents, and anonymous unnumbered documents for each variant. Ordinary package tests never invoke Quarto.

Latest hosted verification — November 1, 2026

Commit 19fb617 passed the required PDF workflow: Windows/Quarto 1.10.19 and Ubuntu/Quarto 1.4.11 and 1.10.19 each completed all nine renders with zero skipped cases. The five-target package checks and pkgdown build also passed. Full evidence is recorded in tools/audit-verification.md. These results cover that commit; review any later package changes before release.

Final review

Reproduce source-package checks

Use a clean R session with development packages installed. Quarto 1.10.19 and its bundled Typst 0.15.1 are the recorded render toolchain; R 4.6.1 is the pinned render CI version. The normal check matrix still covers release/devel/oldrel on three OSes. Documentation/check CI pins Pandoc 3.6.4 because current pkgdown/rmarkdown use flags deprecated by newer Pandoc. For local documentation builds, set RSTUDIO_PANDOC to the directory containing that version and prepend it to PATH; Quarto renders continue to use Quarto’s own bundled Pandoc.

Rscript --vanilla -e 'roxygen2::roxygenise(); testthat::test_local()'
R CMD build .
R CMD check --as-cran typstR_0.1.0.tar.gz
mkdir -p /tmp/typstR-release-library
R CMD INSTALL --library=/tmp/typstR-release-library typstR_0.1.0.tar.gz
R_LIBS_USER=/tmp/typstR-release-library bash tools/run-render-assurance.sh artifacts/release-render
Rscript --vanilla tools/benchmark.R artifacts/benchmark

Keep the tarball hash, complete check log, test results, toolchain report and PDFs. Use a new artifact directory for every render run: the runner refuses stale projects. Record all notes (including expected new-submission notes) and limitations in cran-comments.md; do not claim zero notes without actual evidence.
